signs.text: MORTIMER'S HOLE. In October 1330 the seventeen-year-old Edward III and his friends came up a secret passage into Nottingham Castle and arrested Roger Mortimer, who had ruled in his name. Edward went on to reign for forty-seven years.

text: Sandstone, soft enough to carve with a spoon, and Nottingham has been doing exactly that for centuries. Under the city there are hundreds of caves.
Wedged in a gap in the rock, a ballad sheet printed in very black ink. It is about a man who thought the king was too young to notice.
